title: Improvement to clarity of privacy page
body:
Currently
https://www.whatdotheyknow.com/help/privacy
begins
> WhatDoTheyKnow is run by the charity mySociety: [see more details here](https://www.whatdotheyknow.com/help/about#who). 

Proposal to improve clarity:

>WhatDoTheyKnow is run by [mySociety](https://www.mysociety.org/). 
>
>For full details of mySociety's structure, governance, and details of the relevant registrations with the Information Commissioner and The Charity Commission see: [Who makes WhatDoTheyKnow?](https://www.whatdotheyknow.com/help/about#who)
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
If edits to the privacy page are to be made maybe:
>General Data Protection Act

could become
>General Data Protection Regulations

I think that's just correcting a typo.

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: Message from Mark C: To really clarify things, we should change first line of the [privacy page](https://www.whatdotheyknow.com/help/privacy) to: 'WhatDoTheyKnow is run by mySociety, a project of the charity UK Citizens Online Democracy.'

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
